capabilities: Read, search, write, and organize files, folders, and vault apps in shared vault Surfaces, with every earlier version kept.
description: Lists a vault folder like ls: its live folders, first and ending in /, then its files with their kinds, sizes, newest version numbers, and change times. depth (1–10, default 1) also lists what is inside the folders below. An artifact is a vault app, a small web app kept as one file whose name ends in ".artifact"; listing one lists the files of its newest version. At most 1,000 lines. Paths start with / at the vault's root and match names case-insensitively.

path.description: The folder to list, such as "/Reports". Defaults to "/".

surfaceId.description: The vault Surface's ID, from list_surfaces

name: list_vault
